messages:
Sam (CEO): Quick Q&A following the all-hands on pipeline and partner motion. I want clarity on next steps for the pilot partner and the co-sell playbook.
Tara - VP Sales: Top-line: pipeline coverage is 3.2x; demo->PO conversion at ~8%. Biggest deals are in legal. Question: do we lock pilot pricing now or later?
Maya (Finance): Recommend pilot pricing = time-limited 15% off list. Keeps renewal negotiation clean.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Are we deprioritizing self-serve experiments while we staff mid-market SDRs?
Tara - VP Sales: No, keep self-serve changes, but allocating +2 SDRs to support mid-market AEs for pipeline creation.
Ana (PM, Product): Pilot asks: SAML SSO + webhooks for basic sync. Does engineering need to reprioritize?
Liam (Partnerships): Yep, pilot wants SSO and a webhook that notifies on user provisioning. They'll also request co-branded collateral and a short case-study clause.
Rachel (Ops): If the partner opts for Dedicated, onboarding will need a special runbook: infra creds, network diagram, monitoring hooks, rollback. I'll draft and share.
Ana (PM, Product): Rough eng estimate: 2 devs x 10 days + 1 QA x 5 days for SAML + webhook validation. Can do as a 2-week spike.
Sam (CEO): That works. Please tag tickets with "partner-pilot-q1" and owners.
Tara - VP Sales: Discount guardrails: AEs can sign up to 15% off. >15% requires RevOps + Sales exec approval. We'll add to playbook.
Maya (Finance): Also flag any partner revenue recognition quirks for pilots — I'll loop in accounting.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll produce a 1-page co-sell vs referral flow doc for PMs and growth by Friday.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Nice. Also request: add tracking params for partner-sourced trials so growth can attribute funnel.
Ana (PM, Product): Will add tracking requirements to the spike ticket.
Rachel (Ops): Ops will need a temporary SLA template if Dedicated is used for pilot. I'll include that in the runbook.
Tara - VP Sales: For co-branded materials, legal can commit to a 5-business-day review.
Sam (CEO): Action list: 1) Eng spike for SAML/webhook (Ana + Eng). 2) Rachel to draft Dedicated onboarding checklist and SLA template. 3) Liam to write 1-pager on partner motions. 4) RevOps/Tara to finalize discount bands. Follow-up sync scheduled (calendar invite sent).
all-hands-bot: Follow-up meeting created: "Partner Pilot Sync" Tue 10:00 AM PT (invites sent).
Liam (Partnerships): Sharing partner name via DM per NDA.
Tara - VP Sales: Please surface any resource conflicts ASAP to Sam and me.
Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone 44d. Add any outstanding questions to the calendar invite or the shared doc.
Ana (PM, Product): Spike ticket created and linked in the invite.
Maya (Finance): I'll prepare a short note on pilot billing and recognition for the pilot.
Jamal (Head of Growth): Will set up attribution tags and share the event list in #growth.
Sam (CEO): Closing thread. Follow-ups in the calendar invite and #partnerships.
